highlights.title: Google joins OpenAI and Anthropic in promising new scraping controls
highlights.description: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft pledge to support a new common signal for robots.txt that blocks scraping for AI training.

highlights.title: OpenAI’s Altman Meets Samsung Executives as Chip Crunch Deepens
highlights.description: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman met with Samsung Group’s top executives in South Korea on Saturday to deepen cooperation on memory chips and AI infrastructure as global shortages intensify.

highlights.title: OpenAI Funding Target Cut by $10 Billion as AI Slumps, FT Says
highlights.description: OpenAI has cut its fundraising target by $10 billion as an AI stock selloff and rival Anthropic PBC’s impending public listing complicate its efforts to secure investor commitments, the Financial Times reported.

highlights.title: Anthropic's Claude AI blocks video game cloning and reverse-engineering
highlights.description: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 model blocking attempts at videogame recreation — users also claim their non-malicious generic reverse-engineering tasks are block

highlights.title: SoftBank-Backed OPay Halts IPO to Respond to Regulatory Inquiry
highlights.description: OPay Ltd., a Nigeria-focused payments platform, halted an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange that was supposed to start trading on Friday, citing a regulatory inquiry.

highlights.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
highlights.description: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

highlights.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
highlights.description: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

highlights.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
highlights.description: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.

highlights.title: AI agent used to perform controversial brain surgery on a mouse, Anthropic Sonnet controlled motorized surgery rig
highlights.description: The team had to use Sonnet after Opus 5.5 outright refused to run the experiment, while Opus 5 warned that it could stop working in the midst of the operation.

highlights.title: AI Spending Fears Hammer Big Tech Stocks
highlights.description: Bloomberg Senior Editor for Technology and Strategic Industries Mike Shepard tells Bloomberg This Weekend that disappointing Big Tech earnings are intensifying investor concerns about whether massive AI spending will generate sufficient returns, as Alphabet and Intel come under particular pressure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Lisa Mateo, Shepard also discusses the record $6.3 billion Binance hack and the possibility that North Korean hackers were responsible. (Source: Bloomberg)
